parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. The maximum time range is 31 days. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The storage region. By default, data of all regions is returned. You can specify multiple regions separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes. If you leave this parameter empty, data of the last 24 hours is returned by default.

parameters.name: StorageClass
parameters.description:
The storage class. Valid values:
- **IA**: Infrequent Access.
- **Archive**: Archive.
- **ColdArchive**: Cold Archive.
